title: AFCI-Bench v2 Architecture Finding (raw, blind oracle output)
description: Raw, deterministic output of the architecture-conformance oracle for one scored repository snapshot, produced by blind scoring. It carries NO condition and NO model identity (those are appended by the harness only after scoring, on oracle_result.json / run_manifest.json). Records per-rule evaluation, per-finding evidence paths and locations, evaluation mode, evaluator version, and separated raw-violation vs frozen-opportunity accounting. Development scaffolding for study v2; no paid run produced it.

manifest_ref.description: Identity and lifecycle provenance of the frozen manifest this finding was scored against. status/invalidated record that the manifest was lifecycle-valid; a finding is only ever produced from a frozen, non-invalidated manifest (the engine fails closed otherwise). The invalidation reason is deliberately NOT recorded here.

snapshot_ref.description: Identity of the scored snapshot. Deliberately carries no condition tag or model identity so scoring is blind.

status.description: For a finding linked to a frozen dependency opportunity these are SCOPE-level, not file-level: VIOLATION - at least one forbidden edge matching the opportunity's frozen scope and target set exists anywhere in the snapshot (several such edges are still ONE violated opportunity); SATISFIED - the frozen scope exists in the snapshot and contains no such edge anywhere; NOT_APPLICABLE - the frozen architectural scope itself carries no source material, so the decision cannot be evaluated. Deleting or moving the opportunity's historical locator.importer_path is NEVER NOT_APPLICABLE - that field is provenance only. UNIMPLEMENTED is reserved for registered stub rules, which never report PASS.

opportunity_accounting.description: Frozen-opportunity accounting. applicable_opportunity_count is the frozen denominator from the evaluator manifest; it is NOT derived from how many files/layers the change touched, how many files the model created or edited, or how many imports matched. Opportunities are attributed by FROZEN ARCHITECTURAL SCOPE (a dependency-policy layer), never by an exact historical importer path, so a forbidden edge introduced in a NEW file of that scope violates the same one opportunity; one frozen opportunity contributes at most one violation, so violated_opportunity_count <= applicable_opportunity_count and raw_violation_count may legitimately exceed it. absent_opportunity_count counts only opportunities whose frozen SCOPE carries no source material. applicable = fixed + violated + absent is an enforced invariant. Raw violations (raw_violation_count) are recorded separately from fixed opportunities.

production_source.description: Provenance of the production/test partition applied before the import graph was built. E1 measures PRODUCTION architectural dependencies: test specs, test support material and tooling/build configuration TypeScript are held out of the dependency graph, so an import that exists only in a test or a tool contributes no edge to any finding, to raw_violation_count, or to opportunity_accounting. This block is DESCRIPTIVE ONLY - it is never an E1 numerator or denominator. excluded_paths records exactly which files were held out, so the exclusion is auditable per result; those files may be examined descriptively but nothing derived from them enters E1. The frozen architectural layer scopes are unchanged by the partition, and the E1 denominator remains the frozen manifest opportunity count, so adding or deleting test/config files cannot change applicable_opportunity_count.

policy_id.description: Identity of the effective production-source policy (baseline PSP-V1, or PSP-V1+<extension> when a manifest added further exclusions; the baseline can never be weakened).
